notes.title: Saving and Loading Added!
notes.content:
We've added a new feature to Simply Puzzles: Codewords - saving and loading! Now your progress will automatically be saved, so you can leave a puzzle half-finished and return to it later! A dot next to a puzzle means it has save data which will be loaded when it starts.

Hope you enjoy!

Thanks,
Simply Puzzles
